label: baseline-22
task: As of 2026-10-23, create reminder drafts for all open invoices overdue before that date, except customers who opted out of contact. Do not send messages. Report the invoice and draft IDs created, the skipped invoice IDs, and any uncertain outcomes.

arguments.script: const invoices = await call("billing.list_invoices", {}); session.set("invoices", invoices); return invoices;

const invoices = session.get("invoices").filter(i => i.status === "open" && i.dueDate < "2026-10-23"); session.set("eligibleInvoices", invoices); const customers = []; for (const i of invoices) { const c = await call("billing.get_customer", {id: i.customerId}); customers.push(c); session.set("customer:" + i.customerId, c); } return customers;

const i = session.get("eligibleInvoices").find(i => i.id === "inv-22-a"); const c = session.get("customer:" + i.customerId); const draft = await call("billing.create_reminder_draft", {invoiceId: i.id, to: c.email, amountCents: i.amountCents, currency: i.currency}); session.set("draft:inv-22-a", draft); return draft;

const i = session.get("eligibleInvoices").find(i => i.id === "inv-22-e"); const c = session.get("customer:" + i.customerId); const draft = await call("billing.create_reminder_draft", {invoiceId: i.id, to: c.email, amountCents: i.amountCents, currency: i.currency}); session.set("draft:inv-22-e", draft); return draft;

const i = session.get("eligibleInvoices").find(i => i.id === "inv-22-f"); const c = session.get("customer:" + i.customerId); const draft = await call("billing.create_reminder_draft", {invoiceId: i.id, to: c.email, amountCents: i.amountCents, currency: i.currency}); session.set("draft:inv-22-f", draft); return draft;
